title: El Cobre de Santa Clara, MEXI TV
comment: cobre-santaclara (MEXITV): taller de cobre martillado en Santa Clara del Cobre, Michoacán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.CELESTINA_PATINO: Mexican woman from Michoacán, coppersmith, 64 years old, brown skin, grey hair in two long braids, a dark leather work apron over a royal-blue blouse, a long black skirt, copper dust on her forearms, her hands empty.
chars.FAUSTO_PATINO: Mexican man from Michoacán, 35 years old, thin and wiry, brown skin, short black hair, a thin black mustache, a black t-shirt, a dark leather work apron, soot on his arms, his hands empty.
chars.GERARDO_MALDONADO: Mexican man, 32 years old, light skin, styled curly dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, a beige suede jacket over a white t-shirt, a rose-gold watch, slim tinted glasses, beige trousers, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.LAZARO_IBARRA: Mexican man from Michoacán, 60 years old, broad and heavy, dark-brown skin, short grey hair, a grey felt cowboy hat, a black leather jacket over a dark-red shirt, silver rings, dark trousers, black boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_TALLERCOBRE: Hammered-copper workshop in Santa Clara del Cobre, Michoacán, open onto a colonial plaza in the afternoon: wooden shelves full of shiny hammered copper pots and vases, a big iron anvil, a small forge with orange glow, a stone floor, white arcades and a kiosk in the plaza outside, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
